subject: Willow enterprise — on-site demo runbook, badging & NDA
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@willow.ai>, Caroline Ng <caroline@willow.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Willow enterprise — on-site demo runbook, badging & NDA

Hi Ethan / Caroline,

Thanks again for agreeing to visit our Novato HQ for the Willowsuite integration demo. To keep things smooth on arrival, I put together a short runbook and proposed agenda attached (visitor_agenda.pdf). Key asks from our side:

- Please have the signed mutual NDA returned before arrival (we can accept DocuSign) — I attached the draft we usually use.
- Confirm the attendee list (names + drivers' license state) so Security can pre-print badges.
- Let us know if you'll bring any vendor laptops so we can pre-provision a temporary VLAN and USB-restriction policy.

Proposed arrival window: 10:00–10:30 AM on Thursday, Apr 15. We'll plan a 90-minute demo in Conference A, then a short ops Q&A in the adjacent war room. Parking map included.

Lauren — can you confirm room A booking and two parking passes at the visitor lot?

Caroline / Ethan — if the 15th doesn't work, give me alternative windows and we can shift.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Business Development Lead, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0184
Redwood Inference
From: Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@willow.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Willow enterprise — on-site demo runbook, badging & NDA

Vivek — thanks for the runbook, that looks great. Quick notes:

- Caroline will route the NDA through DocuSign today. Expect signed copy by EOD.
- Attendees: me (Ethan Blake), Caroline Ng, and our Head of Ops, Priya Suresh (priya.suresh@willow.ai). Priya will require VPN access to observe backend logs; is that something you can enable for a 2-hour window?
- We will bring two company laptops and one test server rack key fob — all standard.

One ask on timings: Priya is traveling from NY and her flight now lands late; can we move the demo to 1:30 PM on Apr 15 instead of the morning? That would help her connect directly from SFO without additional transit.

If 1:30 works, we'll plan to arrive around 1:00 PM, be pre-badged if possible.

Ethan

Vivek / team — I moved the Conference A booking to 13:30–15:30 on Apr 15 and reserved the adjacent ops room as backup. Two visitor parking passes are reserved for the lot by the gate; I've attached the map to the folder and shared a QR code for quick entry.

Olga, can Security pre-print badges for: Ethan Blake, Caroline Ng, Priya Suresh (drivers' license states: CA, CA, NY)? If Priya doesn't arrive in time and needs to join remotely, can IT enable a temporary VPN token and restrict access to the logs bucket only?

Also flag: our guest laptop onboarding requires AV inspection (to ensure no persistent agents) — Security prefers the devices stay in guest VLAN unless signed off by IT. I'll have the laptop handoff checklist ready at the front desk.

Lauren

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Willow enterprise — on-site demo runbook, badging & NDA

Ethan / Caroline — welcome to Novato. A few operational points before arrival:

1) NDA: we received the DocuSign envelope this morning and I countersigned — attached (willow_signed_nd a_draft.pdf).
2) Badging: Security has pre-printed guest badges for the three attendees; please bring a photo ID for pick-up at the lobby kiosk.
3) Parking: Use the visitor lane and scan the QR at the gate (see parking_map.png). The lot is gated until 6pm.
4) Devices & network: IT will provision a time-limited VPN token scoped to the logs bucket and the demo VM. Please don't plug unknown USB devices into our machines; we'll provide USB-restricted docking.

Point person on arrival: Lauren will meet you at the lobby at 13:00 and escort you to Conference A. If anything changes last-minute, text Lauren at +1 (415) 555-0107.

See you Thursday — safe travels.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Attachments: willow_signed_nd a_draft.pdf, parking_map.png
